# Pocitel teaching materials

The user supplied Pocitel menu pages and two food images on 18 October 2026
and asked for website development in the portfolio and an educational website
example. These three files are unmodified copies of those uploads. `sources.json`
records filenames, dimensions and SHA256 hashes. CSS controls presentation only.
The original image creation method, including any use of AI, is not verified.

`examples/pocitel.html` is an AI PATH teaching mockup using the supplied name,
menu palette and materials. It does not claim a commissioned or official café
website, a measured sales result, food availability or a live ordering service.
No address, hours, testimonials or customer contacts have been invented.
The café name is typeset as text; no new graphic logo was fabricated.

Prices and pairings are copied from the English BEST PAIRINGS page:

| Pairing | Base TL | Pairing TL | Saving TL |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Çılbır + Turkish Tea | 360 | 345 | 15 |
| Pancake + Cappuccino | 485 | 460 | 25 |
| Fruity Granola Bowl + Iced Matcha | 535 | 510 | 25 |
| Smoked Turkey Focaccia Sandwich + Iced Americano | 415 | 395 | 20 |

Filtering is display-only; selection stays in page memory, is cleared on reload,
and makes no orders or network submissions. The school card, service-learning
choice and example connect to the existing `build` program; all 15 IDs are kept.
